articles.title: Six communities creating a culture of tsunami readiness
articles.description: Communities around the world are rising to the challenge of tsunami resilience, creating a global wave of readiness, so that warnings and evacuation routes work for the people most at risk of being left behind.

articles.title: Regional workshop on coastal resilience: strengthening early warning, preparedness, and anticipatory action in the Mediterranean
articles.description: The regional workshop in Lebanon will bring together Mediterranean Arab States and partners to strengthen coastal risk knowledge, multi-hazard early warning systems, preparedness, and anticipatory action through regional cooperation.

articles.title: Lebanon marks World Tsunami Awareness Day with national workshop on coastal resilience, science, and youth engagement
articles.description: On World Tsunami Awareness Day, more than 80 university students in Lebanon engaged in a national workshop and student competition focused on coastal resilience, early warning systems, and translating scientific knowledge into anticipatory action.

articles.title: UNDRR and Japan showcase tsunami innovation at Geneva policy dialogue
articles.description: To commemorate World Tsunami Awareness Day – marked each year on 5 November – UNDRR held an innovation showcase and policy dialogue, generously hosted by the Permanent Mission of Japan in Geneva.

articles.title: Droughts, floods and food systems risk dialogue – Part III: Turning Food System Risk into Food System Resilience: Innovative Solutions for Drought Management
articles.description: Participants will explore how risk-reduction finance can buffer against global food price shocks and volatility, and how investment in regenerative farming techniques and climate-smart agriculture can contribute to food-system resilience.

articles.title: Mozambique learns from Japan’s expertise in disaster risk reduction
articles.description: As Mozambique works to strengthen its disaster risk reduction mechanisms, representatives led by INGD, and supported by Ministry of Finance and Eduardo Mondlane University, embarked on a study tour to Nagoya, Japan.

articles.title: Arab States Mark IDDRR 2026 through regional cooperation and community-led preparedness
articles.description: Arab States marked IDDRR 2026 through regional dialogue and community initiatives promoting disaster preparedness and resilience.

articles.title: Webinar: Advancing Inclusive and Last-Mile Early Warning Systems in Africa
articles.description: This webinar aims to advance dialogue, knowledge sharing, and collaboration on strengthening inclusive and last-mile early warning systems across Africa as a key enabler of the Early Warnings for All initiative.

articles.title: Niamey charts a path towards improved urban resilience
articles.description: The City of Niamey and UNDRR organized a capacity-building assessment on disaster risk reduction from 8 to 10 August 2026, as part of MCR2030.

articles.title: National Indigenous Disaster Resilience, Monash University
articles.description: NIDR is a research program within the Faculty of Arts, Monash University. Established in 2022, NIDR is Australia’s only Indigenous-led, nationally focused program investigating how major disasters affect Indigenous people, communities and organizations.

articles.title: Let’s take charge of resilience. By working together we can be tsunami ready says UN Secretary-General António Guterres
articles.description: On this World Tsunami Awareness Day, let’s take charge of resilience. By working together we can be tsunami ready – and save lives whenever the waves strike.

articles.title: Concept note: World Tsunami Awareness Day 2026
articles.description: The theme of World Tsunami Awareness Day 2026, on 5 November, is “Be Tsunami Ready: Resilience Starts With You”. It builds on WTAD 2025’s emphasis on investment in preparedness by focusing on individual and community action.

articles.title: Resilience, Adaptation and Inclusion in Nepal
articles.description: RAIN is an FCDO-funded programme supporting Nepal’s climate adaptation, mitigation, disaster risk management, and shock-responsive social protection. RAIN TA SLU is implemented by a consortium led by Mott MacDonald.

articles.title: UNDRR advances climate resilience, early warning systems, and risk-informed water management at Cairo Water Week 2026
articles.description: At Cairo Water Week 2026, UNDRR promoted risk-informed water management, early warning systems, and climate resilience through regional cooperation.
